description: Figure 3 presents the distribution of samples across six subtasks within the MMRA benchmark. The chart is a pie chart comprised of six slices, each representing a different subtask. The “Environment” slice is colored blue and represents 128 samples (28.28%). “SimilarityMaterial” is colored orange and accounts for 100 samples (22.13%). The “SimilarityEvent” slice is yellow and represents 90 samples (19.89%). “UsageSimilarity” is colored green and comprises 100 samples (22.13%). “AppearanceSimilarity” is colored purple and represents 90 samples (19.89%). Finally, “NearSemanticity” is colored pink and accounts for 63 samples (13.95%). The chart includes a legend identifying each subtask and its corresponding color, and each slice is labeled with both the number of samples and the percentage it represents. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
